text_block_list.text: One holiday. Heading to the shopping district with Mihono Bourbon to buy supplies...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The "Sweets☆Stamp Rally" is officially underway!
We're looking for tons of participants~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A sweets... stamp... rally...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Bourbon-chan and company!
Are you interested in the event?
choice_data_list: What kind of event is it?
What kind of event is it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We eat sweets at each shop in the district
and get one stamp for every treat!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And once you collect all 50 stamps...
you get to eat completely custom-made sweets!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...!
Completely... custom-made...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In other words... you're saying "it's possible to create the ultimate sweets containing fruits that boost adrenaline and nutrients that increase muscle mass"?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "...It's completely custom-made, after all! It'll be fine! The shopkeeper hosting it is supposed to figure something out!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reporting to Master.
The total caloric value of 50 desserts is an immense figure.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, the completion reward is enticing. ...Very much so.
...Awaiting your instructions, please.
choice_data_list: ...Sorry, it's a shame, but let's pass on this.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I get it~! Calorie control is super important when you've got races coming up, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Understood.
However, allow me to correct one point.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To me, Master's instructions are absolute truth.
Therefore, there is no need to apologize. In fact, if anything—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master.
Thank you for your consideration toward me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohhh~~...
Umm... did we just get flexed on?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... You two are such great friends~.
It made me feel all sweet inside too!

Although I had to give up on participating in the event...
hearing those kind words warmed my heart.

And so, we ended up participating
in the stamp rally...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*... *gulp*.
Item 50, Deluxe Mega Sundae, cleared.

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for joining in~! All right, without further ado,
let me hear the details for your custom order!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Um, it was... the flawless sweets, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a sweet packed with fruits that help relieve fatigue
and nutrients that boost muscle gain.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In other words, I request "sweets containing apples, natto, oysters, miso, kusaya, and protein."

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheh, I see!
My 30 years of patissier experience is tingling with excitement...!!

Later on, a pitch-black cake arrived, seemingly packed
with every single ingredient... and Mihono Bourbon
relished eating every last bite.
